scope.target: Selected-payload navigation, actionable local targets, component dependency closure, archive user-view parity, and the owner-directed bounded upgrade-test horizon
constraints: Validate the post-mapping selected payload rather than source-tree existence
Classify anchors, examples, code spans, templates, placeholders, and external URLs before failing navigation
Keep source-only guidance visibly non-actionable or exclude it from portable indexes
Require explicit component reference/dependency closure for every supported selection
Start active upgrade testing at v0.6.0 and allow exactly one immediate-predecessor automatic route for each later governed package
Treat every breaking release as a migration checkpoint whose minimum automatic source is the immediately prior checkpoint
Do not call the controlled combined projection a v0.13 release candidate
